cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your garden gnome is home. Leave the box flat, please; I'll unpack it with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is there so much padding? I can lift him out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lift the packets separately. He isn't in one piece, but each piece is wrapped so we can put him together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All the pieces? I want his fishing rod back on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rod hasn't come back. Start with the face, please; we have the whole smile. I'll lay out what we've got before we discuss replacing anything.
